license_verified_how: HF Hub API: cardData['license'] == 'apache-2.0' for OS-Copilot/ScreenSpot-v2, queried independently 2026-09-24; also matches better-jev-bench's own verification in datasets/screenspot_v2/manifest.toml.
vendored_via: better-jev-bench (sibling repo asp616848/better-jev-bench), not fetched from HuggingFace directly
export_command: cd better-jev-bench && uv run bjb export --slice heldout --datasets screenspot_v2 --out <dir>
export_command_note: ScreenSpot-v2 is dataset.eval_only=true in better-jev-bench's own manifest; `--slice public` emits 0 records for it by design (better_jev_bench/export.py's slice-gating logic, verified by reading the code and then actually running the export). `--slice heldout` is the only real path to any items, and it emits 858, not the manifest's headline item_count of 898 (= 40 public + 858 heldout) -- the 40 public rows are unreachable through the sanctioned export path for an eval_only dataset.
vendored_record_schema_note: better-jev-bench's own bjb export record shape (8 text keys + images, PRD.md 13a.11 / better-jev-bench PRD §13.4). Each record's own `options` is a real binary (label, cyclic-neighbor-distractor) pair -- see better_jev_bench/datasets/screenspot_v2.py's docstring. benchmarks/screenspot_v2/loader.py reframes these into genuine N-way items; it does not consume this file's `options` field as the final item schema.
images_note: Images are NOT vendored into this repo -- resolved fresh at load time from better-jev-bench's own content-addressed cache (data/images/screenspot_v2/<sha256[:2]>/<sha256>.<ext>) and re-hashed before use. See benchmarks/screenspot_v2/README.md's 'Vendoring: images vs. metadata' section for the full tradeoff writeup. 356 distinct images, ~370MB, behind these 858 records.

reframing.method: group all 858 exported rows by shared image; take the union of every row's own (label, distractor) option pair as that image's real candidate pool; emit one N-way choice item per original row, options = the full pool (sorted), expected = that row's own real label
